module_summary: 32-bit global branch history shift register: shifts in predictions on predict_valid and reloads train_history plus outcome on misprediction.

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: Global history shift register; shifts in predict_taken or reloads from train history on mispredict.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Misprediction rollback command; takes precedence and loads history from train_history.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction valid; enables shifting predict_taken into the history register.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted branch direction bit shifted into history LSB.

anchors.name: train_history
anchors.why: Pre-mispredict history restored into the register on rollback.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual branch outcome appended to train_history on rollback.

groups.name: History shift register
groups.description: 32-bit branch history register with shift and parallel-load paths.

groups.name: Predict port
groups.description: Prediction-side update: valid plus taken bit shifted in.

groups.name: Train rollback port
groups.description: Misprediction rollback loading train_history concatenated with train_taken.
